newsitem.title: USA: AMR Corp, pilots enter cooling off period.
newsitem.headline: AMR Corp, pilots enter cooling off period.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines and its pilots' union were placed into a 30-day "cooling off" period which could lead to strike action or a lockout in their escalating labor dispute, the National Mediation Board (NMB) said.
A NMB spokesman said American had declined binding arbitration, and that the cooling off period would begin at midnight Wednesday.
"We have issued a letter which triggers the 30-day cooling off period," spokesman Harry Bickford said.
He said that, if no agreement is reached in that 30-day period, the union would be free to strike while the carrier could implement new work conditions or simply lock out its pilots.
The 30-day period will end at 12:01 am EST on February 15.
